paper_version.title: Efficient Inference for Noisy LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation

official_code_version.snapshot_scope: Selected inference-time method, runtime, configuration, example, evaluation, and test files; 26 files retained. Training paths, datasets, model weights, generated outputs, credentials, benchmark answers, and files larger than 1 MB are excluded.

excluded_trainable_objects: task-specific neural router, compressor, guard, verifier, or policy
integration_screening.selected_artifact_scope: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as automatic evaluators of generative AI outputs, a paradigm often referred to as "LLM-as-a-judge." In practice, LLM judges are imperfect predictions for the underlying truth and can exhibit systematic, non-random errors.
integration_screening.basis: The retained artifact is an inference-time harness, memory, retrieval, scheduling, security, observability, or executable evaluation mechanism. Model-training branches and trained task-specific components are outside this packet boundary.

benchmark_leakage_check.task_template_boundary: Datasets, task instances, annotations, answers, generated runs, and result directories are excluded from the selected code snapshot.
